g.text: The improvement appears in all four time folds
Expanding time validation: train on earlier data, evaluate on the following half-year. Lower deviance is better.
Source: models/oof_metrics_by_fold.csv. Line axes use their actual score ranges, not a zero baseline.
Temporal validation supports the current selection; it does not replace an untouched future test.
